body:
# ☸️ The Path of Enlightenment: A Buddhist Mod for Minecraft

Have you ever thought that Minecraft was a bit too... violent? All that endless slaughter of cows for leather, chopping down innocent trees, and slaying monsters just to reach the End. 

This mod completely changes how you play by introducing the core philosophies of **Buddhism** into Minecraft. It forces you to rethink your survival strategies and ask yourself: *Can you actually beat Minecraft while maintaining perfect Karma?*

Since this is my **first mod**, I really hope you enjoy it! Please note that some bugs might occur along the way—if you find any, I’m truly sorry, and I appreciate your patience as I learn and improve!

---

## 🌟 Core Mechanics & Challenges

To achieve true enlightenment, you must adhere to the spiritual laws of the universe. This mod introduces two major complications to your standard gameplay:

### ☯️ The Karma System
Every action has a reaction. Your spiritual purity is constantly tracked:
*   **Negative Karma:** Harming innocent passive creatures, unnecessary destruction, and violent acts will accumulate bad karma. Beware, as low karma might bring unfortunate spiritual consequences.
*   **Positive Karma:** Protecting life, replanting what you harvest, and living in harmony with nature will elevate your soul. 

### 🥬 Strict Vegetarianism (Veggie Mode)
Say goodbye to steak, pork chops, and cooked chicken. To respect all living beings, you must sustain yourself entirely on a plant-based diet. Eating meat will severely damage your Karma and your spiritual progress. Better start that wheat, carrot, and potato farm on day one!

### 🔮 Hidden Features
There are various secret mechanics, spiritual events, and "chips" integrated into the world that you will discover naturally as you play. Keep your eyes open and your mind mindful!

---

## 🧘 New Recipe: The Meditation Cushion

Need a moment to clear your mind, restore your inner peace, or perhaps interact with the mod's deeper mechanics? You can now craft a **Meditation Cushion**!

### Crafting Recipe:
*   **8x Wool** (Any color, surrounding the edges)
*   **1x Stick OR 1x Bamboo** (Placed dead center)

> **Tip:** Regular meditation might just be the key to cleansing your bad Karma after an accidental slip-up!
